title: LaBraM
paper_title: Large Brain Model for Learning Generic Representations with Tremendous EEG Data in BCI
core_mech: 以 VQ neural tokenizer 提供离散 EEG patch 目标，再用跨通道/时间 Transformer 做 masked code prediction。
core_mech_en: Trains a vector-quantized (VQ) neural spectrum tokenizer to predict Fourier amplitude/phase spectra of EEG patches, then pretrains a cross-channel Transformer via masked code prediction.
input_desc: 多通道连续 EEG 片段及通道身份
input_en: Multi-channel continuous EEG recordings with arbitrary montage channel counts and recording lengths
output_desc: 通用 EEG 表征与下游分类/检测输出
output_en: Universal EEG representation transferable across seizure detection, sleep staging, emotion, and motor BCI

adapter.name: LaBraM (downstream EEG architecture)
adapter.mechanism: The authors' TemporalConv and NeuralTransformer operate on channel-by-time patches with separate learned electrode and time embeddings and Q/K normalization.
limitations: Architecture-only exercise: VQ neural tokenizer, masked code prediction, full pretraining corpus and pretrained LaBraM capability are not reproduced.
Synthetic waveforms are interpolated to two 200-sample patches per channel. This is a shape adapter, not an assertion of EEG sampling rate or a source of extra information.
Synthetic channel IDs 1..C have no anatomical electrode identity. Real EEG requires explicit montage, channel-order, unit and sampling checks.
Width 100 and depth two replace the original base preset; all weights are random.
